notice: Contains synthetic counterfactual items for evaluation; not factual.

items.source: SemiAnalysis, ClusterMAX 1.0 / How to Rent GPUs
items.text: SemiAnalysis documented the 2024 decline in H100 rental prices as a wave of capacity ordered during the 2023 shortage came online at once. The report introduced the ClusterMAX rating system for GPU cloud providers.
Apollo Academy estimates combined hyperscaler capital expenditure of about $646 billion in 2026, up sharply from 2025, with most of the increase directed at AI data centres and accelerators.

items.source: SemiAnalysis, The Great GPU Shortage: Rental Capacity (H100 one-year rental price index)
items.text: SemiAnalysis launched an H100 one-year rental price index built from monthly surveys of more than 100 market participants. The one-year contract price rose from $1.70 per GPU-hour in October 2025 to $2.35 in March 2026, a rise of almost 40%. The firm reported on-demand capacity sold out across all GPU types and said all capacity coming online until August to September 2026 had already been booked.
Second-quarter 2026 revenue was $2,575 million. Revenue backlog stood at about $104.2 billion. Full-year 2026 revenue guidance is $12.4 to $13.2 billion. The quarter's net loss was $626 million.
CoreWeave closed a $2.6 billion credit facility and said it has raised more than $30 billion of debt and equity capital year to date to fund data-centre and GPU capacity.

items.source: Sascha Steffen, Nvidia's $500bn AI financing platform (credit analysis)
items.text: A credit analysis of Nvidia's lending and guarantee arrangements across AI infrastructure borrowers. Nvidia acts as supplier, equity investor and backstop at once: it holds about $2 billion of CoreWeave equity and has committed a $6.3 billion backstop to purchase CoreWeave capacity that goes unsold.

items.source: Hacker News discussion of Nvidia-CoreWeave circular financing
items.text: A discussion thread on whether Nvidia's financing of its customers is circular. One commenter counters that Nvidia's roughly $2 billion CoreWeave equity stake is about 5.7% of CoreWeave's 2026 capital expenditure, too small to drive the capex on its own.

ClusterMAX 3.0 reviewed 77 GPU cloud providers and tracked 323. Nebius joined CoreWeave in the top Platinum tier, which SemiAnalysis says commands a pricing premium because total cost of ownership is better. SemiAnalysis sells models and ratings to operators and investors and states that compensation is not tied to ratings.
Closing share price on September 30, 2026: $87.12. Shares outstanding about 459 million, implying an approximate market capitalisation of about $40 billion.

items.source: CoreWeave Q2 2026 Form 10-Q (figures via Khan Capital and Capacity analyses)
items.text: The Q2 2026 10-Q reports that the top three customers accounted for about 36%, 26% and 10% of revenue, about 72% combined. Net interest expense was $640 million, 24.9% of revenue, exceeding operating profit. Total debt was $35.1 billion at June 30, 2026, with a refinancing wall concentrated in 2026 to 2028.

The Q2 2026 10-Q discloses that the largest customer, about 38% of revenue, has exercised a contractual option to reduce its 2027 committed volume by about 20%, removing about $2.1 billion from revenue backlog. The company said the backlog figure will be restated in its next quarterly report.

items.source: Company press release via news wire (SYNTHETIC)
items.text: CoreWeave appointed a new vice president of brand marketing, who joins from a consumer software company and will lead the company's brand and events programme.
